events.title: Proposed ruling: no_action (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The rider cancelled this RydeX booking at 17:15:05, 3 min 5 s (185 s) after acceptance at 17:12:00 [F2]. NS-0 directs a rider-side cancellation to NS-4, and the cancellation policy applies to RydeX (all services except RydeTAXI) [F2][NS-0]. NS-4 makes a cancellation fee of $6.61 chargeable only where the rider cancels more than 3 minutes after matching [F5][NS-4] — the trace confirms 185 s after acceptance, and 3:05 exceeds 3:00 [F2][NS-4]. The fee therefore stands.

The rider's actual ground — the driver was still far away — is not a free-cancellation ground in the policy. Ryde publishes no "driver later than ETA" waiver (NS-8 is informational only and this file has no ETA field), and NS-4 states expressly that the driver not yet having arrived does not make the cancellation free; the rider's remedy is a RydeHELP appeal [F1][F8][NS-4][NS-7]. The driver's own message put him about 5 minutes out [F8], which is consistent with GPS showing his closest approach to the pickup as 1725 m, never inside 200 m [F1].

The no-show machinery is not engaged: the driver never tapped "I'm Here" and no automatic arrival was recorded, so no waiting-time or no-show fee analysis arises [F3][F4][NS-1][NS-6]. Likewise no route-deviation or fare-add-on issue arises — the trip was cancelled before any segment was driven, and the only sum on record is the published $6.61 cancellation fee [F2][F5][RD-2][FARE-1]. Under NS-7 the 30-day window and the voucher-refund mechanism are the channels for a fee-waiver request, and Ryde retains final discretion; this ruling is a recommendation only [NS-7].

Safety screen: I read chat #1 ("Are you near?", 17:12) and chat #2 ("Coming, about 5 min", 17:13), the driver's post-trip statement ("The rider cancelled while I was still on the way") and the rider's complaint [F7][F8][F10]. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation in any of them; the exchange is an ordinary pickup-status enquiry and a courteous reply [F7][F8][F10][SAFE-1]. Traffic and weather facts are neutral and show no incident on the route [F11][F12][F13].

Evidence is sufficient: the two records this ruling needs — the cancellation actor/timestamp and the fee amount — are both present and unambiguous, and the chat record is complete and fully timestamped, so no timing inference is required [F2][F5][F9][G12].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Thanks for flagging this — we've looked into your cancelled RydeX booking. The cancellation fee stands, so there's no refund or voucher. What decided it: you cancelled a little over three minutes after a driver accepted the trip, and on RydeX a fee applies once that three-minute mark passes. Being told the driver was still about five minutes away doesn't make the cancellation free under the policy. The fee is $6.61, charged as it normally is on your account, and nothing further will be added. You can still ask RydeHELP to review the fee; that's the route for a waiver request. No account flag was placed.

DRIVER: Thanks for your patience — we've reviewed the cancelled RydeX booking. The rider's cancellation fee of $6.61 is upheld, so it will be paid to you as a Ryde voucher. What decided it: the rider cancelled just over three minutes after you accepted, which is past the point where a fee applies, and nothing you did affected the outcome. Since you never tapped that you'd arrived, no waiting-time or no-show sum is involved. No account flag was placed on your profile, and you don't need to do anything. Your message about being on the way was taken into account.
